title: Socratic Skill Learning: Interleaving Teaching and Practice for Transferable Agent Skills
abstract: arXiv:2610.17860v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agent Skills improve LLM agents by making task knowledge reusable across sessions. Learning transferable Skills requires evidence about a procedure and its conditions of use, which a successful task attempt can leave untested. We introduce Socratic Skill Learning (SSL), which interleaves expert teaching with Student practice. An Educator guides investigation while the Student remains the sole environment operator and Skill author, able to question, test, and adapt advice. To test reuse beyond the learning task, we construct SkillTransferBench, with 35 task families and 408 executable cases, pairing public variation specifications with held-out evaluation in fresh solver sessions. On the main 22-family, 155-case cohort, Fixed-Window SSL reaches 0.801 utility, versus 0.723 without a Skill, 0.761 for adapted Trace2Skill (trajectory distillation), and 0.751 for adapted SKILL-KD (contrastive distillation). translated_title: 苏格拉底式技能学习：交错教学与实践以获得可迁移的智能体技能
translated_abstract: 智能体技能通过使任务知识能够跨会话复用来提升LLM智能体的能力。学习可迁移的技能需要关于某个操作流程及其适用条件的证据，而一次成功的任务尝试可能无法验证这些条件。我们提出了苏格拉底式技能学习（Socratic Skill Learning, SSL），它将专家教学与学生练习交错进行。教育者引导探索过程，而学生始终是唯一的环境操作者和技能编写者，能够质疑、测试并调整所获建议。为了检验技能在超出学习任务之外的复用能力，我们构建了SkillTransferBench基准，包含35个任务族和408个可执行案例，将公开的变体规范与全新求解器会话中的留存评估相配对。在主要的22个任务族、155个案例的队列上，固定窗口SSL达到0.801的效用得分，而无技能基线为0.723，改编后的Trace2Skill（轨迹蒸馏）为0.761，改编后的SKILL-KD（对比蒸馏）为0.751。在三组模型对上（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出苏格拉底式技能学习（SSL），通过教育者引导与学生主导实践相交错的方式，让LLM智能体学会可跨任务迁移的技能，并构建包含35个任务族的SkillTransferBench基准，证明其显著优于无技能基线和现有轨迹蒸馏等技能学习方法。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Socratic Skill Learning (SSL), which interleaves educator guidance with student-led practice to teach LLM agents transferable skills, and proposes the SkillTransferBench benchmark (35 task families, 408 cases) demonstrating that SSL significantly outperforms both skill-free baselines and existing trajectory distillation methods.
